name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=item/ui_menu, descriptor=command_menu_dispatch). No address residue. Accurately names the function's role: the dispatcher for the 4-way item command popup (Use/Give/Sort-Equip/Drop) opened from the inline action submenu.
purpose: 4-way item command popup (Use / Give / Sort-Equip / Drop) opened when the player picks 'Item' in the inline action submenu during their battle turn; dispatches to the chosen sub-action and reports whether the turn was consumed.
logic_summary: Copies the 4-int options template (@0x51F05 {8,9,10,11}) and 4-int state template (@0x53F32 {0,0,0,0}) into locals. If the char has no usable inventory slots, return -1. Pre-disables 'Give' (menu_state[1]=1) when there is no adjacent ally tile (fd2_compute_aoe_targets cursor range 1 kind 3 == 0). Renders the menu, loops fd2_settings_menu_input_step until non-zero, closes it, recomposites, snapshots cursor world pos. On menu cancel (input==-1) return -1. Dispatch on data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx: 0=USE (loop: pick usable slot via modal gate=1; on commit look up item entry, set anim_phase=item[0x12]+2, compute AoE target set (range item[0x10], is_spell item[0xD]==0x17, kind item[0x15]) and wait for target (mode item[0x15]); anim_phase=1, compute apply-AoE (range item[0x12], kind item[0x15]) into final_aoe; if spellbook item[0xD]==0x17 require caster job_id 0x18 Magician with mp_max>=0x14 else target=-1, on success wait mode 6 then stash cursor as teleport dest and pan to caster; if target!=-1 apply use effect, mark acted, return 1; else pan back and re-prompt; modal cancel returns 0). 1=GIVE (pick slot gate=0; compute adjacent-ally AoE into malloc(100), wait mode 3 for recipient, find char under cursor, pan back to origin tile, free buffer; if target chosen add this slot's item to recipient; if recipient full open their modal to pick a swap slot (remove recipient slot + add my item + remove my slot + add swapped item) else just remove my slot; set player_action_result_code=1; always recalc stats, return 0). 2=SORT/EQUIP (fd2_equip_unequip_inventory_menu, return 0). 3=DROP (pick slot gate=0; if confirmed remove it; recalc, return 0).

params.name: char_idx
params.semantics: Index of the acting character into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr. The sole caller fd2_player_inline_action_menu_dispatch passes its own char_idx straight through. Used as the subject of every inventory/modal/stat operation in the body.
params.reason: Already accurately named char_idx in the src (no param_1 residue, no address suffix); matches usage as the acting character index.

returns.semantics: 1 = action committed (turn used; from the USE branch after applying the use effect). 0 = re-prompt the outer inline menu (GIVE/SORT/DROP paths, USE modal cancel). -1 = no usable items (menu not opened) or outer command menu cancelled. Ghidra types the return undefined4 but the sole caller consumes it as int (-1/0/1).
